blocks.text: Turn your focus time into an adventure. Create your first companion, recruit more for free, then choose who will travel.

items: Choose Start Quest, a duration and difficulty.
Select one to three companions and up to three optional upgrades.
Depart, focus, and let the party travel and fight automatically.
When time is up, review the concise recap and choose Finish.

blocks.text: Keep up to five companions; send one to three on a quest.

items: Start Quest sets a focus session and prepares an expedition.
Camp portraits open companion details; Camp Jobs assign Gold work, Arcana study, or rest.
Recruit adds a free companion while a roster slot is open.
Altar unlocks rituals with Artifacts and activates them with Arcana.
Graveyard shows fallen companions and available return-to-life options.
Save opens save files. The timer controls include alerts, Recall, options, and the floating clock.
The ? button reopens this guide. Dismissing a companion removes them from the active living roster.
Turn the timer and difficulty dials, then choose the glowing Start Quest button.
Difficulty 1 suits levels 1–2; 2 suits 3–4; 3 suits 5–6; 4 suits 7–8; and 5 suits 9–10.
One-minute sessions are peaceful and fixed at one skull.
The destination and opposition are generated and revealed only after departure; enemies do not scale to your party or boons.
Choose up to two temporary boons. They cost Gold, affect the whole party, and expire on return or Recall.
The clock keeps running through combat and while the open game is in the background. Closing the process does not advance time.

Recall stops future encounters and forfeits completion rewards and XP, while previous finds and consequences remain. The remaining countdown continues on the road home; Recall again to arrive immediately.

blocks.text: Combat is automatic. HP keeps companions alive; Armor and Ward absorb most incoming damage first.

items: Barbarian — heavy melee
Knight — protection
Ranger — ranged damage and control
Rogue — speed and debuffs
Mage — magic and Ward
Cleric — healing and support
Bard — inspiration; Encore renews one ally special
Druid — healing and control; Entangling Bloom delays and heals

blocks.text: Living participants earn XP from actual quest time, faster on harder quests, up to level ten. A knockout can cause lasting injury or death. Survivors remain out for that expedition. HP recovers at camp; Healing removes one injury but does not restore HP.
Gold buys expedition upgrades. Arcana activates unlocked rituals. Companions at camp can work for Gold or study for Arcana.

items: Successful quests longer than one minute can find Magical Artifacts. At the Altar, choose Unlock Next Ritual; future rituals stay hidden until their turn.
Rituals can protect a party, remove an injury, or return a fallen companion. Reanimated skeletons cannot level and cannot be reanimated after dying again.
Quest settlement is saved to history and the latest report; returning parties go directly to the normal hub.
Use Save before leaving the game when you want to keep your latest progress.
